info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Oracle WebLogic Server Monitoring and Diagnostics API
Servers
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all monitored servers

items.docs: Returns monitoring information for all servers in the domain including their current state, health, and basic runtime metrics.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get server monitoring information

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Returns detailed monitoring information for a specific server including state, health, JVM metrics, and subsystem runtimes.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get server JVM metrics

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Returns JVM runtime metrics for the specified server including heap usage, garbage collection statistics, and thread information.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get server thread pool metrics

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Returns thread pool monitoring data for the specified server including thread counts, queue lengths, and throughput.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List work managers on a server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Returns monitoring information for all work managers on the specified server.

info.name: Health
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get server health status

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Returns the overall health state of the specified server along with health status of individual subsystems.

info.name: Clusters
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all monitored clusters

items.docs: Returns monitoring information for all clusters in the domain including member servers and cluster health.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get cluster monitoring information

params.name: clusterName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic cluster

items.docs: Returns detailed monitoring information for a specific cluster including member server states and cluster health.

info.name: Data Sources
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all data source metrics

items.docs: Returns monitoring metrics for all JDBC data sources across all servers in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get data source metrics

params.name: dataSourceName
params.description: The name of the JDBC data source

items.docs: Returns detailed metrics for a specific JDBC data source.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Test a data source connection

params.name: dataSourceName
params.description: The name of the JDBC data source

items.docs: Tests the connection pool for the specified data source by reserving and releasing a connection.

info.name: JMS
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all JMS server metrics

items.docs: Returns monitoring metrics for all JMS servers in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get JMS server metrics

params.name: jmsServerName
params.description: The name of the JMS server

items.docs: Returns detailed metrics for a specific JMS server.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List JMS destinations

params.name: jmsServerName
params.description: The name of the JMS server

items.docs: Returns monitoring metrics for all destinations on a JMS server.

info.name: Applications
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all application deployment metrics

items.docs: Returns monitoring information for all deployed applications across the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get application deployment metrics

params.name: appName
params.description: The name of the deployed application

items.docs: Returns detailed monitoring information for a specific deployed application.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List servlet metrics for an application

params.name: appName
params.description: The name of the deployed application

items.docs: Returns servlet-level monitoring metrics for a deployed web application.

info.name: Diagnostics
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List WLDF system resources

items.docs: Returns a list of WebLogic Diagnostic Framework (WLDF) system resources configured in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get a WLDF system resource

params.name: resourceName
params.description: The name of the WLDF system resource

items.docs: Returns details of a specific WLDF system resource.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List diagnostic data access runtimes

items.docs: Returns information about diagnostic data access runtimes that provide access to collected diagnostic data.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Query diagnostic data

params.name: runtimeName
params.description: The name of the data access runtime

items.docs: Executes a query against diagnostic data collected by the WebLogic Diagnostic Framework. Supports querying harvested metrics, server log entries, and other diagnostic data sources.
